_note: Which record file OWNS each class of fact. Every other record links to the owner instead of restating it — a fact written twice is a fact that will be wrong in one of the two, with nothing to say which. Edit the owners and patterns to match YOUR records; a class whose pattern matches nothing in its own owner fails the gate closed, so this table cannot quietly go stale. Declare stalenessCheck only with a reason: "sometimes-empty" for a record that is legitimately empty early in a strand, "never-in-owner" for a forbidden restatement shape that is not a record at all. Declaring one buys an obligation: the class must also carry "examples" — at least one line the pattern MUST match — because the opt-out is exactly what removes the live record's power to prove the pattern still recognizes anything. An empty, null, or non-list "examples" is refused; it pins nothing while reading like a guarantee.
